note: Governed dark-deployment control surface. All controls are EXTERNALLY configurable governed flags (env/config, never code). Defaults are fail-closed: a newly deployed image starts DARK and publishes NOTHING until each control is explicitly enabled. This file documents the control contract + safe defaults; it does not enable anything.

master_enable.meaning: global Advanced-v1 master switch; false -> entire Advanced-v1 pipeline dark

instrument_selection.note: which instruments publish is DATA (registry), never code

readiness_guard.meaning: migration-025 metadata columns must be present; absent -> MIGRATION_REQUIRED -> fail closed (no publication)

oanda_streams.invariant: exactly one canonical OANDA stream; activation adds NO stream/subscription/per-instrument worker

startup_policy.calendar_gate: policy provenance must be production-ready or the instrument fails closed

reporting.dark_vs_active: each family reports enabled/authorised/publisher_mode + per-instrument ACTIVE/NOT_ENABLED; a dark surface reports published:0 and touches no client
